name: A chat call that only picks a label, a yes or no, or a score

A prompt that asks for one of a fixed set

find.regex: ^(?!\s*(?:#|//|\*|/\*|--|"""|''')).*\b(?:rate|score)\b.{0,90}\bon a scale (?:of|from) \d|\bfinal score as a single number between\b

A tool whose only job is to return one label
A function named for classifying with a model

why: A full chat call to pick one answer from a fixed list costs more and takes longer than a decision model built for it. It doesn't fit open-ended text, labels built at runtime from user data, or maths and dates.
